programs.title: Home for Good
programs.desc: Art and the team extend their hand to help firefighter and paramedic, Ronnie Estep, a 27-year-old father whose old home burned to the ground; in just seven days, the team tackles a complete makeover of the kitchen but goes above and beyond by renovating the living room, office space, dining room, plus a special surprise in store for this deserving family.
